#!/usr/bin/env python3
import hopsworks
import pandas as pd

# Login to Hopsworks
h = hopsworks.login()
fs = h.get_feature_store()

print("Creating feature table customers12050b version 1...")

# Create version 1 with initial export
fg_v1 = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="customers12050b",
    version=1,
    description="Initial export of customers table",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    event_time="updated_at",
    online_enabled=False
)

# Load initial export data
df_initial = pd.read_csv("data/initial_export.csv")
print(f"Initial export shape: {df_initial.shape}")
print(f"Initial export columns: {list(df_initial.columns)}")

# Save to version 1
fg_v1.save(df_initial)
print("Version 1 saved successfully")

print("\nCreating feature table customers12050b version 2...")

# Create version 2 with new schema
fg_v2 = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="customers12050b",
    version=2,
    description="New export with breaking schema change",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    event_time="updated_at",
    online_enabled=True  # Enable online/real-time access
)

# Load new export data
df_new = pd.read_csv("data/reload/new_export.csv")
print(f"New export shape: {df_new.shape}")
print(f"New export columns: {list(df_new.columns)}")

# Save to version 2
fg_v2.save(df_new)
print("Version 2 saved successfully with online access enabled")

print("\nDone!")
